scope: existing_eight_samples; fixed product; one graph instance; bounded program

previous_general_baseline.interpretation: general candidate/comparison baseline, not minimum hardware and not a current implementation

static_metadata: buffer live intervals and alias proof
fixed phase permissions and constant owners
route schedule and resource reservation proof
permanent_data: all supported product programs and error paths
model/layer tables and bounded parameter ranges
runtime_required: dynamic MoE ID/rank and checked lookup
not_required_as_generic_runtime_system: generic role/type parser on every packet
generic reference-count table when consumer schedule is statically proven

architecture.mother: one prefabricated PC/loop sequencer; blocking SERVICE instruction
architecture.performance_status: functional baseline only; throughput/latency not accepted
architecture.existing_services_vs_new: only native leaf FSMs/S loader exist; mother and outside service controllers are new candidates; MEM/NUM hardware not supplied by naming IDs

NUM_ownership.sharing: service8 serial subprofiles; each arithmetic implementation/range/table remains to be accepted

architecture.S_helper: S_CTRL services the current child's bounded subtransaction while mother waits; this helper is not a second foreground job
architecture.G_job_mode: one fixed fn/gated per streaming job; native four-stage pipeline plus input/output counters; next job after drain

program.general_scalar_ALU: bounded 32bit compare/count/shift and 64bit address addition; expert multiply replaced by checked ROM lookup; no implicit general vector arithmetic
program.program_overflow: GAP_PROGRAM_CAPACITY; enlarge prefreeze or provide a proven lowering, never remove semantic legality

command_templates.schema_selection: compiled SERVICE opcode, no runtime role/schema search
command_templates.R_identity_bind: NONE/OPEN/EXEC/COMMIT fixed field insertion from current root/position; op0/op6/op7 layouts differ
command_templates.M_record: 256bit: native_cmd_data64, sourceA_word32, sourceB_word32, destination_word32, element_count32, native_index16, op4, load/control_flags12, reserved32
command_templates.MEM_record_pair: 512bit explicitly budgeted: external_byte_address64, S_word_address32, byte_count32, direction/ordering/error flags32, source/destination limits128, remaining224 reserved/adapter-specific; exact platform interface deferred
command_templates.parameter_origin: constants come from permanent layer/head/tile-indexed tables or checked model-data scalar loads; not one common scale for all layers
command_templates.not_in_control_templates: weights, gamma vectors, taps, A_log, per-channel coefficients and quantization metadata are model payload unless explicitly enumerated; their storage/MEM transfer cost is separate, not free ROM

meanings: specified output range stored and ACKed
completion.holding: one common completion register remains stable until mother accepts; next SERVICE cannot launch before this credit returns
completion.not_equivalent: phase completion does not release retained native context; T publication not final MEM completion

control_transport.command: one instruction header followed by four descriptor words, or eight words for explicit MEM pair; no packet interleaving
control_transport.descriptor_assembly: ROM emits 64bit beats directly through prebuilt routing into the selected service's local 64B capture; ten physical captures total640B even with one globally active job; no second complete mother fetch bank
control_transport.capture_validity: ordinary descriptor marks four words valid, extended pair eight; do not execute until all required words accepted, never read stale unused words
control_transport.ROM_beat_holding: one current 64bit descriptor beat register and separate completion beat register plus counters/route lock are included in the 32B transport budget; no 64B mother descriptor cache
control_transport.header_holding: selected service preserves header fields in its budgeted 32B local sequencer state until completion
rules: reserve full parameter/completion and endpoint space before first command word
keep word and valid stable until ready
only dispatch native work after complete descriptor
parent waiting must not block S helper or native response capture
control_transport.extra_pipeline_stages: not included; count explicitly if required for placement/STA

phase_and_reservation.retained_state: small M/N/R/T phase registers plus fixed program ownership; RESUME same phase versus REENTER new context explicit
phase_and_reservation.N: BEGIN/STATS/FINALIZE/EXP/REPLAY subjobs can return; expected/accepted/returned counters remain until group ends
phase_and_reservation.R: OPEN/load/EXEC/read/commit/revoke/export subjobs can return; pending_history continuation follows native guards; pending_state blocks reload; save op12 before next EXEC/COMMIT
phase_and_reservation.M: result lock covers entire accumulation; no restore; materialize before reuse
phase_and_reservation.T: one lease; old-batch spool and release precede BEGIN new batch
phase_and_reservation.buffer_reservation: compiler emits finite S slot intervals and branch lifetime proof; baseline reserves all simultaneously needed source/output/response space; small runtime occupancy/phase flags only
phase_and_reservation.S_response_rule: take and capture a response before requesting the next dependent S access; no held S response waiting on another S read
phase_and_reservation.fork_join: static consumer schedule/branches and explicit collection; no generic refcounts unless later concurrency requires them
phase_and_reservation.conditional_branch: compiled SKIP/merge path and selected counters; no wait for unexecuted branch
phase_and_reservation.publication: compute, stored-data ACK, R local commit, root publication, T batch publication and consumption remain distinct

MoE_runtime.top_ID_payload: one S word of 8 U16 IDs; another word for 8 Q14 weights; charged to active tensor allocation
MoE_runtime.lookup: per-layer ROM expert_base[40]64bit; no assumed general 64bit multiply
MoE_runtime.checks: ID/rank bounds; unique-ID proof from constant0..39 table may remove duplicate checker only after proof; otherwise visited mask40bit included in record

state_root_design.root_grain: one recurrent layer root jointly names that layer's full state and conv-history versions; not one entry per native R tile
state_root_design.runtime_index: fixed selected-product layer-to-root map; root_index<24 or32 as applicable; no hash table or allocation tree
state_root_design.current_region: conv/state expected and ACKed prefix counts, output prefix and byte ACK counters, first failed tile/native identity; one active region, no out-of-order bitmap
state_root_design.parity: active_bank_selector selects immutable old bank; writes target the other bank; change selector only after complete required ranges are ACKed and program publication gate allows
state_root_design.two_pass: conv output saved -> local history commit -> op14 saved ACK; later old state restored -> state EXEC -> op12 saved -> local state commit -> op11 saved ACK; next OPEN only after required saves
state_root_design.no_global_atomicity_claim: root selector can logically bind state/history for cooperating consumers; no automatic R/T/MEM joint transaction or crash consistency
state_root_design.failure: keep published old selector where still unobserved; dirty next bank quarantined until all writes drained; if root/output already visible record partial_completion and stop, not blind old-state replay
state_root_design.payload_placement: system has external memory; real bases, capacity, interfaces and transfer ordering deferred; metadata is not the 2MiB/4MiB per-layer state payload
state_root_design.beyond_32_or_concurrent_regions: requires new budget/proof; do not silently restore general256-root scope

drain_and_errors.overflow: do not wrap; stop new work, drain all native/helper/MEM/consumer obligations, then explicit coordinated reinitialization or terminal error
drain_and_errors.no_tag_assumption: native interfaces remain serial and ordered; no replacement command admitted until previous response is consumed; late MEM responses after reset require platform drain/reset contract
drain_and_errors.before_native_valid: cancel pending local instruction and release proven unused reservations
drain_and_errors.valid_presented: keep valid/data stable until handshake; then drain unless native protocol explicitly permits withdrawal
drain_and_errors.loader_accepted: continue all A/B obligations to done; no abort by deasserting destination readiness forever
drain_and_errors.M_failure: preserve failed_rows; no whole-command blind append retry
drain_and_errors.R_commit_accepted: protect output/staging; wait actual COPY response; successful local change is irreversible by revoke
drain_and_errors.T_failure: sticky protocol_error; no invented commit_error; revoke only in native allowed states and outside protected cross-resource window
drain_and_errors.MEM_failure: deferred interface must report acceptance/completion and allow safe drain; timeout is diagnosis, not cancellation acknowledgement
drain_and_errors.error_retention: first fault record survives until inspected/coordinated recovery; unsupported optional service reports UNIMPLEMENTED, not success

memory_scope.cost_reuse: only after explicit static lifetime/route proof; no proof means retain both reservations and capture cost

runtime_storage_estimate.status: logical_state_bytes_candidate_only; not minimum lower bound, synthesis or physical total
excluded: NUM arithmetic/LUT state beyond listed scratch

permanent_storage_estimate.not_hidden_parameters: layer/head-indexed command, shape, address and scale references explicitly listed; model tensor constants remain separate data payload
not_proven: complete eight programs fit1024 instructions each
permanent parameter and route bindings physically feasible
